## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe one concrete trigger and what changes for the user. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

State the checks actually run and their results. For skill behavior changes, include the synthetic fixture, prompt, model, and observed output. Explicitly list checks not run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and referenced file paths/links exist.
- [ ] Examples are fully synthetic and contain no employer material, production telemetry, credentials, customer information, or internal URLs.
- [ ] Behavior changes include an example or an explanation of why one is not applicable.
- [ ] Claims distinguish observed results from illustrative output and assumptions.

## Limitations

Describe any remaining gaps or compatibility assumptions.
